# CI/CD file inventory: this repository vs the four link-foundation templates
# Generated by comparing the immutable snapshots under references/templates/
# against the working tree. 'CI files' = anything under .github/ or scripts/.
# Snapshot manifests carry the .snapshot suffix required by issue #1014; the
# comparison below strips it so a snapshot file matches its live counterpart.
#
# Regenerated after the fixes in this pull request landed in the working tree.
# `.github/workflows/workflows.yml` and `.github/zizmor.yml` therefore appear as
# SHARED; before this pull request they were template-only, and that absence is
# the evidence for defect D10 in the README.
